home.metaDescription: Guests scan one QR code and share photos, videos, voice messages and wishes. No app, no account.

event.changePlanHelp: Sets the plan and recomputes when the media is deleted. This is not a payment.
event.suspendHelp: A suspended event is closed to guests at once. The host keeps the dashboard and slideshow.
event.suspendedNote: This event is suspended. Guests cannot open it.
event.deleteBody: Deletes the event, all its media and its reports for good. This cannot be undone.

reports.note: Resolving or dismissing a report does not suspend the event. Suspend it from the event page.

plans.intro: Changes apply to every event on the plan straight away, because limits are read live.
plans.maxUploadMbNote: Per-kind caps still apply: photo 15 MB, voice 10 MB, video 200 MB.
plans.retentionDaysNote: Existing events pick up a new retention when their host edits them or an admin changes their plan.
plans.freeNote: The Free plan must stay active at RM 0.

templates.intro: Deactivating a template hides it from the card builder for new choices. Cards already using it keep working.
templates.codeNote: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 3 to 40 characters. It cannot be changed later.

audit.note: Times are in Malaysia time. Guest names and messages are never recorded here.
